notes: Product-family vendor read on Patterson's own pages (four pattersondental.com pages, all HTTP 200 and not thin). The canonical home https://eaglesoft.net/ failed with a network error and was not retried, and it has no browser read yet; C02 (creator) and C08 (Windows) are the claims it might settle, and the Patterson snapshots do not settle them. Four cited pages were read for C04's cause: thinkaegis.com carries the cloud-based sentence; slashdot.org and firststopdental.com do not; selecthub.com answered 403 and has since been read once in a browser (pass 2): it is a third-party page, so it classes nothing, and it does not carry the C04 sentence, so the cause stays thinkaegis.com. The pages_read entry for eaglesoft.net (key 7de2aaa5ff8329f4) has metadata only, no snapshot. Pass 2: added C28 (per-user or annual license pricing basis, unverifiable) and a C19 instance, both from the Dentrix and Eaglesoft table in one Google AI Overviews answer; the other comparison-table rows repeat claims already listed for the same answers. The consistency check kept C04 wrong: Patterson's own FAQ answers that Eaglesoft is server-based and requires a physical server. Not coded: name-only mentions, Townie vote shares, market share, review ratings, the 200+ Service Club specialists (staff count), the 30 years of refinement (product age), capability descriptions (line-item accounting, imaging depth), savings comparisons, and the hedged line about upfront and maintenance costs. Judgement calls: C15 treats included training as the learning resources Service Club lists; C23 and C24 split the Global Payments line into a true integration and an unverifiable exclusivity claim.
